subject.title: WhatsApp channel: expose ctwa_clid from Click-to-WhatsApp ads in session metadata

question: Should WhatsApp CTWA attribution data be exposed only as per-turn untrusted structured context, exposed to opted-in plugin hooks, or persisted as session metadata for later Conversions API use?
rationale: The extraction is bounded, but `ctwaClid` is an advertising click identifier and the issue explicitly asks for prompt/session exposure, so automation should not choose visibility, plugin access, or retention policy.

options.title: Per-turn untrusted context only
options.body: Extract CTWA fields in the WhatsApp plugin and expose them only through the existing fenced untrusted structured-context prompt path, without durable persistence.

options.title: Plugin-hook attribution payload
options.body: Define a typed WhatsApp attribution payload for opted-in plugin hooks so a Conversions API plugin can consume it without putting the identifier into every prompt.

options.title: Persist session attribution
options.body: Store the first CTWA payload on session state only after maintainers define retention, redaction, export, and deletion behavior.

recommendation.title: Per-turn untrusted context only
recommendation.body: Extract CTWA fields in the WhatsApp plugin and expose them only through the existing fenced untrusted structured-context prompt path, without durable persistence.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history across the prompt metadata, plugin-boundary, and session-adjacent surfaces that need the security/product decision.
